title: VCP-X-Torch Extension Schema
description: Session handoff extension for the Value-Context Protocol (VCP). Carries relational state, trajectory, and key norms across agent session boundaries.

quality_description.description: Human-readable summary of the relationship state.

trajectory.description: Directional indicator derived from self-model history.

primes.description: Key norms or patterns to carry forward, each truncated to 80 characters.

handed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of torch generation.

session_count.description: Number of sessions in the relationship lineage.

gestalt_token.description: Compact dimensional state snapshot. Format: space-separated Key:Value pairs.

date.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime of the session.

gestalt_token.description: Gestalt token at the time of handoff.

session_count.description: Total number of sessions in the lineage.

first_session_date.description: ISO 8601 date of the first session.

torch_chain.description: Ordered list of torch summaries, oldest first.
